astranl.do_not_use_when: you need a quote, an individual permit or a person
astranl.example_intent: How busy is Dutch construction right now?
astranl.next_possible_action: cite the provenance; the same fact is at https://astranl.com/api/construction
astranl.proof_level: aggregates of official registers with measured accuracy; not signed
astranl.returns: permits_90d, lead_times status, open_tenders count, cbs periods, laws_next_365d, provenance per part
astranl.use_when: you want the current state of Dutch construction activity before going deeper

description: One-call overview of Dutch construction facts: permit publications last 90 days (national), lead-time status, number of open public works tenders, latest CBS periods, construction laws taking effect in the next 365 days. Permit kind accuracy is measured, not assumed: manual validation gate B on a 200-row sample (2026-10-05) gave precision 0.98, Wilson 95% lower bound 0.94, 11% unclassified; the current figures come back in accuracy, and the unknown bucket (OVERIG, BESLUIT_ONBEKEND) is shown separately. Read-only aggregates: no permit rows, publication identifiers, titles, addresses, points or names; permit counts below 5 per authority per kind are shown as <5 and totals that would reveal one are lower bounds (>=n). Every answer carries source provenance (source, source_url, licence, as_of/retrieved_at, method, status) and an exposure block.
name: construction_summary
